lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha. Why does Master SHIKI crave so much blood? If he needs only enough to live, mine should be sufficient, as it is for you.”
“Yes. If survival were all he wanted, your blood would be more than enough; a resonator’s blood is richer and more delicious than ordinary human blood.
But procreation and blood-drinking are different things.
Quantity alone can never satisfy the thirst. Every human being tastes different. Once a creature grows accustomed to drinking blood, it keeps feeding in search of flavors unlike those it has already known.”

lines.japanese:
背骨にたかった昆虫は、ずぶずぶと、首のあたりから脳内に入ってくる。
　何十という昆虫が爪をたてて、キィキィと鳴いて、背中にたかっている。
　その虫が入るたびに――――いいようのない衝動に支配されかける。
　コロセ、と。
　遠野秋葉を殺し尽くせと、頭の中で繰り返される。
　その昆虫の名は、殺意というモノに違いなかった。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
The insects clinging to my spine burrow wetly through the base of my neck and into my brain.
Dozens dig in their claws, squealing as they swarm across my back.
With every insect that enters――――an indescribable impulse almost takes control.
KILL HER.
The command repeats inside my skull: kill Akiha Tohno and leave nothing behind.
Those insects could have only one name: murderous intent.

　そんなコト、本当はどうだっていい。
　俺は、どうして―――解って、あげられなかったんだろう。

I cannot control my own actions.
How am I any different from the murderer called SHIKI?
No.
That does not truly matter.
Why couldn’t I―――understand her?

「―――――――琥珀、さん―――――」
　……槙久の手記にあった言葉。
　感応者という単語。
養子としてではなく、ただの道具として扱われる為に引き取られた琥珀と翡翠。
　その意味。
　槙久付きという事の意味を、俺はまったく理解していなかった。
理解、しようとさえしなかった。

―――毎日毎日、飽きる事なく―――
　秋葉はそう言った。
　槙久が何をしていたか、俺には考えるまでもない。
　槙久が俺と同じように暴力的な衝動に支配される人間なら、琥珀に何をしたかなんて、わかりきってる。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――――Kohaku―――――”
Words from Makihisa’s journal.
The word resonator. Kohaku and Hisui, taken in not as adopted children but as tools to be used.
What that meant.
What it meant for Kohaku to be assigned to Makihisa. I had understood none of it, never even tried.
―――Day after day, without ever tiring―――
That was what Akiha said.
I do not need to wonder what Makihisa did.
If violent impulses ruled him as they rule me, then what he did to Kohaku is obvious.

―――いつも。
いつも窓際にいた少女。
　外に出る事も、助けを求める事も、知らなかった。
　まだ幼い琥珀に対して、槙久は情けなんてもたなかった。
　あの手記に書かれていた事だ。
　槙久は、琥珀を道具としか見ていなかった。
　ただ、子供のように。
自分の欲情を、少女に叩きつけていただけだった。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
―――Always. The girl who was always at the window.
She knew neither how to go outside nor how to ask for help.
Makihisa showed no mercy to Kohaku, still only a child.
His journal made that clear.
To him, she was nothing but a tool.
Like a child. He had simply taken his lust out on a little girl.

「いいのよ、私もお父様の事は軽蔑しているから。
　あの人は醜悪だった。
あの人が実の父親だと思うと、私だって殺したくなる。
　そうでしょう？
　ご自分の中の血に抗いきれず、まだ子供だったあなたを欲情の捌け口にして、毎日毎日、飽きる事なく陵辱していたんですものね。
　だからね、琥珀。
本当はあなたが私やシキを恨んでいる事ぐらい解ってるわ」

Every day spent behind a single pane of glass, watching the rest of us play.

When I left the mansion, she entrusted me with something precious to her.

lines.japanese:
「――――愚か、な」
　……胸がつまる。
　呼吸ができない。
　秋葉を殺したくなる自分。
　こんなにも無神経な自分。
「ごめん――――ごめん、琥珀さん―――――」
　意識がゆらぐ。
　そのまま体は昏睡する。
　俺は、初めて。
　自分のこの力で、自分自身を、殺したいと思った。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“――――Fool”
My chest closes.
I cannot breathe.
The self that wants to kill Akiha.
The self so callous it could do this.
“I’m sorry――――Kohaku, I’m sorry―――――”
My consciousness sways.
My body sinks into oblivion.
For the first time.
I wish I could turn this power upon myself and die by my own hand.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"----Foolish."
…… My chest constricts.
I can't breathe.
My self that wants to kill Akiha.
My self that couldn't even understand what was going on.
"Sorry----sorry, Kohaku-san------"
My consciousness wavers.
My body enters a stupor.
For the first time,
I want to kill myself using my ability.

「ですが秋葉さま。
志貴さまの容体は日に日に悪くなってきています。
姉さんに薬を処方してもらわないと、志貴さまは立ち上がる事もできなくなるのではないですか？」
「……そうね。
けど、それはそれで都合がいいわ」

「翡翠、兄さんが起きたらしばらくは学校を休むように言って。
ここ数日元気がなかったみたいだし、顔色が良くなるまで部屋から出してはダメよ。
　学校には私のほうから連絡を入れておきます」

lines.maoEnglish:
“But, Miss Akiha. Master Shiki’s condition is worsening by the day. Unless my sister prepares medicine for him, Master Shiki may soon be unable even to stand.”
“True. But that may be convenient in its own way.”
Akiha murmurs, considering.
“Hisui, when Brother wakes, tell him he is to stay home from school for a while. He has looked unwell for days, so do not let him leave this room until his color improves.
I will notify the school myself.”

I’ll be fine by morning, so there’s no need to be so overprotective.”

There is nothing for me to grieve.

悲しい事は簡単に目に付くし、倖せは難しすぎて解らない。

lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
Misery is easy to recognize, while happiness is too difficult to understand.
If you measure wretchedness by circumstances, there is always someone lower.
If the worst fate means suffering unbearable grief and being forced into an intolerably painful life, then the answer would simply be never to have been born.
―――To me.
The inability ever to be born seemed saddest of all.

lines.japanese:
「志貴さま。
人より優れた体力を持つ方は、夜のうちに何度も熱をだしたりはいたしません。
昨夜、志貴さまが何度発熱したのか覚えておられますか？」
「え―――俺、なんかしたのか」
「……昨夜の話です。
志貴さまがお眠りになられた後、すぐに熱を出されました。
発汗もひどく、頻繁にお体を拭いて、一時間ごとに様子を見にきたほどです」
――――我ながら、それは凄い。
　凄いんだけど、こうも翡翠に迷惑をかけていると少しはしっかりしなくては、と恥じいってしまいそうだ。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. A person with extraordinary stamina does not develop repeated fevers through the night. Does Master Shiki remember how many times his fever returned?”
“What―――happened to me?”
“This happened last night. Soon after Master Shiki fell asleep, his temperature rose. He perspired so heavily that we had to wipe him down repeatedly and check on him every hour.”
――――Even by my standards, that is impressive.
Though after causing Hisui so much trouble, I’m beginning to feel ashamed enough to try taking better care of myself.

“…”

“Don’t worry; this injection barely hurts. Master Makihisa also fell ill from time to time.

I feel as though I might lose my mind.
Kohaku speaks Master Makihisa’s name as though it means nothing at all.
Why must she perform so perfectly―――?

A distant moon.
Night is dark, and a veil of trees covers the world.
The ground juts up in serrated ranks, like sawteeth.

Only the great cry of a reed warbler comes from the thicket.

My instincts ache for home. As a child—a very small child—I raced through these woods.
Whenever we went outside, it was always midnight.
My parents and their brothers and sisters disliked the eyes of people, and almost never went out by day.

Beside that eye, the fresh blood across the field is no more than washed-out yellow ocher.

　七夜志貴は、森の奥へと歩いていく。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
A voice calls in the distance.
Being alone is frightening, so I have to go deeper into the forest.
Beyond the veil of trees, clatter, crack, boom, squelch—the same festival-like uproar repeats itself.
Shiki Nanaya walks deeper into the forest.

lines.japanese:
野原を通り過ぎた時、さっきの赤色について考えた。
　可哀相に。
　アイツは背中でゆらめいていた蜃気楼に憑かれて、いつか疲れて、あんなふうになってしまったのだろう。
　アイツは強そうだったけど、同時にとても危うく見えた。
　アレでは長く生きられないな、と結論を出して、森の奥へと進んでいった。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
As I pass beyond the field, I think about the red from before.
Poor thing.
The mirage flickering at its back must have possessed it; someday it grew tired and ended up that way.
It looked strong, yet terribly precarious at the same time.
Concluding that it would not live long, I continue deeper into the forest.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
After passing through the field, I think back about that redness I saw earlier.
How pitiful.
When did it become so tired and hazy like that?
It seemed incredibly strong, but at the same time, very fragile.
After finding out that it doesn't have much longer to live, I continue towards the heart of the forest.

lines.japanese:
窓から差しこんでくる朝日で目が覚めた。
「―――――――あつ」
　寝ている時にまた熱でも出したのか、寝巻が濡れている。
　……それにしてもおかしな眠りだった。
　大昔に作られた音のない喜劇……よく知らないけど、黒い山高帽をかぶった髭の役者がアレコレと酷い目に会う、あんな感じの映画を見せられたような夢だった。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
Morning sunlight through the window wakes me.
“―――――――Hot.”
My nightclothes are soaked, as though I ran another fever in my sleep.
Still, that was a strange sleep.
A dream like being shown some comedy from the distant past, one without sound—I know little about them, but the kind where a mustached actor in a black bowler hat suffers one disaster after another.

lines.mirrorMoon:

"-------Hot."
My pajamas are drenched with sweat.
…… It seems I had a weird dream.
It was like that really old silent comedy film…… I'm not too sure, but that one where that actor with a black derby hat and a mustache keeps getting in all sorts of situations… it was a dream where it felt like I was watching a movie.

lines.japanese:
「……そういえば、有間の家にいたころは夢なんかみなかったっけ」
　というか、子供の頃から夢というものには無縁だった気がする。
　俺の眠りは深すぎて夢を見る深度じゃない、と主治医は言っていた。
　なら、この屋敷に帰ってきてから続けてみる夢は、夢というより記憶の断片なのかもしれない。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“Come to think of it, I never had dreams while I lived with the Arimas.”
In fact, I seem to have had nothing to do with dreams since childhood.
My doctor said my sleep was too deep to reach the depth where dreams occur.
Then perhaps the dreams I have kept seeing since returning to this mansion are not dreams so much as fragments of memory.

「……って。
それを夢っていうんじゃなかったけ」
　ま、そういった小難しい事を考察するのは学者さんに任せて、一学生である遠野志貴は学校に行くべきだろう。
「―――よし、起きるか」
　ベッドから体を起こす。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“Wait. Isn’t that what a dream is?”
Well, I will leave such difficult speculation to the scholars, while Shiki Tohno, mere student, ought to go to school.
“―――All right—time to get up.”
I raise myself from the bed.

lines.japanese:
「―――――え」
　体が動かない。
「なっ……動かないって、どうして！？」
　歯を食いしばって体に力をこめる。
　力みすぎて頭に血が上って、軽い眩暈が起きるぐらいまで努力して、ようやく上半身を起こせた。
「ぁ………あ、つ…………」
　体中が熱い。
「くそ……昨日より、悪くなってる……」
　昨日はただ全身が重いだけだった。
なのに今は、腕を動かすなんて事さえ辛い。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――What”
My body will not move.
“It won’t move—why!?”
I clench my teeth and drive strength into my body.
I strain until blood rushes to my head and a faint dizziness takes me; only then do I manage to raise my upper body.
“Ah—ah, hot”
My whole body is burning.
“Damn—it’s worse than yesterday.”
Yesterday my entire body was merely heavy. Today even moving one arm is agony.

…
……
………

　それとも動力のきれたロボットか。
　ともかく体が動かない。
　けど、そのわりには意識ははっきりしているし、痛みはまったく感じない。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“What is happening to me?”
At this rate, I’m a corpse.
Or a robot after its power has run out.
In any case, my body will not move.
And yet my mind is perfectly clear, and I feel no pain at all.

　そう、彼女を呼ぼうとして思いとどまった。
　昨日、俺は琥珀さんを抱きよせて、あんな事を言ってしまった。
　琥珀さんがどう思ったかは知らない。
　……琥珀さんと翡翠の入れ替わりを俺が知っている、という事までは気がついていないとは思うけど、それでも今は会いにくい。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku―――――”
I begin to call for her, then stop myself.
Yesterday I pulled Kohaku into my arms and said all that.
I do not know what she thought of it.
She probably has not realized that I know she and Hisui switched roles as children; even so, she is difficult to face right now.

　来てくれ、と言おうとして止まった。
　声は出せるけど、大声をあげようとすると眩暈がする。
　……大声をあげるにも筋力を使うから、その負荷で脳に血がたまっていくような感覚。
「はっ―――――」
　軽く息を吐く。
　こうなったら翡翠が起こしに来てくれるまで、こうして待っているしかないだろう。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hisui―――Akiha, could one of you―――”
I stop before I can ask them to come.
I can speak, but trying to shout makes me dizzy.
Even raising my voice requires muscle; the strain feels as though blood is pooling inside my brain.
“Hah―――――”
I breathe out lightly.
At this point, I can only wait like this for Hisui to come wake me.

…… Shouting requires muscle use, and that probably puts a strain on the blood to my brain.
"Ahh-----"
I breathe shallowly.
All I can do is just wait like this until Hisui comes to wake me.

―――結局、俺は今日も学校を休んだ。
　俺を起こしに来た翡翠は顔を蒼白にして秋葉を呼びにいった。
　話を聞きつけた秋葉が駆けつけてきて、これは秋葉や琥珀さんでも対処できないと判断したのか、わざわざ医者を呼んで検査をしてもらった。
　検査結果はいつも通り原因不明。
　あとはお決まりの、ベッドで一日休むべし、という秋葉のご命令が下された。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
―――In the end, I miss school again today.
Hisui turns white when she comes to wake me and runs to fetch Akiha.
Hearing what has happened, Akiha rushes in and, apparently deciding that neither she nor Kohaku can deal with this, goes so far as to summon a doctor to examine me.
As always, the examination finds no cause.
Then comes Akiha’s customary decree: one full day in bed.

The sun goes down.
Unable to do anything but lie in bed, I stare through the window.
“Damn it…”
If it was going to come to this, I should have settled matters with SHIKI last night.
Every moment I remain here means more victims for the vampire. For all I know, SHIKI drank someone’s blood after Akiha and I returned home.

lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
Was my judgment wrong?
Last night. Whatever Akiha said, should I not have stayed in that alley and lain in wait for SHIKI?
“Tonight—tonight I have to do it.”
I cannot indulge in complaints that my body will not move.
The only thing that matters now is stopping SHIKI as soon as possible.

Every hair on my body rises.
―――What.
Who is standing before me now?
Who is exerting this pressure, so crushing that merely looking at them threatens to stop my breath?

There's something wrong with you……!!"

It must have worked, because she swallows her words.

It is the exact opposite of my natural power, but I must have laid a curse like that on you.
And so you miraculously revived, while from that day onward my body bore a heavy shackle. It is only natural, when you think about it. I gave you half the life that should have sustained me.”

“Yes. As long as I keep you alive, I must continue using the alien blood of the Tohno. When I do, my blood as a human being grows thin.

To prevent that, I must keep the Tohno blood from flowing as much as possible. But then giving you strength takes everything I have, and I cannot sustain my own body.”

Ready at any instant. Driven to deal with the thing before me, so far removed from the person called Akiha Tohno.

　あの時だって―――私はちゃんと兄さんに自分の気持ちを伝えたのに、兄さんは何も言ってくれなかった。
　私は兄さんを愛しているって伝えたのに、どうして私以外の女を見ようとするんですか……！」

That night too―――I told you exactly how I felt, yet you said nothing.
I told you I loved you—why do you keep looking at women other than me…!?”

Her shoulders heave as she breathes, and she bites her lip in wounded frustration.
“―――――――Akiha.”
“Brother. I don’t care if I cease to be human. If that lets you live, I don’t care what becomes of me.
So―――Brother, please look only at me. Akiha has waited for you all this time. Now that you have finally come home—don’t betray me.”

発汗していた体から、汗が引いていく。
　肉が焼けるかもしれないぐらいに熱くなった肌が、ひんやりと冷えていく。
　額には濡れたタオルの感触。
　体をわずかに起こされて、唇にコップをつけられた。
　こくり。
　少しだけ冷えた水が、喉を滑り落ちていく快感。
――――――。
　すぐ近くには人の気配。
lines.label: s422
lines.maoEnglish:
The sweat slicking my body begins to dry.
Skin that had burned hot enough to roast the flesh beneath it slowly turns cool.
I feel a damp towel against my forehead.
Someone raises me a little and presses a glass to my lips.
I swallow.
The water is faintly cool, and the pleasure of it slipping down my throat is exquisite.
――――――……
Someone is close beside me.
